chunks: These are the limits set by God, and those who follow the commandments of God and the Prophet, will indeed be admitted to gardens with streams of water running by, where they will for ever abide; and this will be success supreme.

key_terms.حُدُودُ اللَّهِ: Limits or boundaries set by God

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of supreme success (al-fawz al-'azim) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as the concluding summary of the preceding legal rulings in Surah An-Nisa, emphasizing that adherence to divine boundaries leads to ultimate felicity. The promise of 'flowing rivers' symbolizes the eternal, unchanging nature of Paradise, while the phrase 'supreme success' (al-fawz al-'azim) highlights the spiritual and worldly benefits of obedience to both God and the Prophet.
